code: at_bat_sim(   pitcher_id,   batter_id,   start_date,   end_date,   num_simulations = 1000,   num_cores = 2,   seed = NULL,   league_rates = NULL,   prior_pa = 50,   location_prior_pa = 20,   multiplier_range = c(0.5, 2),   game_types = c("R", "PO"),   verbose = FALSE )

title: Simulate At-Bat Outcomes Between a Pitcher and a Batter — at_bat_sim
text: pitcher_id Numeric. ID pitcher (Statcast / MLBAM pitcher ID). batter_id Numeric. ID batter (Statcast / MLBAM batter ID). start_date Character. start date data retrieval period "YYYY-MM-DD" format. end_date Character. end date data retrieval period "YYYY-MM-DD" format. num_simulations Numeric. number plate appearances simulate. Default 1000. num_cores Numeric. number CPU cores use parallel processing. Default 2. seed Optional integer. supplied, results reproducible, including across different values num_cores. Default NULL draws seed current R session, calling set.seed() beforehand also makes results reproducible. league_rates Optional named numeric vector league outcome rates names strikeout, walk, single, double, triple, home_run, flyout, groundout. normalized sum 1. Default NULL uses approximate MLB average (see Details). prior_pa Numeric. Prior strength, plate appearances, used shrink player's outcome rates toward league_rates. Default 50. location_prior_pa Numeric. Prior strength, plate appearances, used shrink batter's hit rate pitch type location bin toward batter's pitch-type rate, pitch-type rate toward batter's overall rate. Default 20. multiplier_range Numeric vector length 2. location/pitch-type multiplier applied hit outcomes clipped range. Default c(0.5, 2). game_types Character vector Baseball Savant game type codes include. Default c("R", "PO") regular season postseason; add "S" spring training. verbose Logical. TRUE, prints sample sizes pre-location outcome rates. Default FALSE.

title: Simulate At-Bat Outcomes Between a Pitcher and a Batter — at_bat_sim
text: Data. Pitch-level Statcast data players downloaded Baseball Savant date window. Rates computed per plate appearance (PA): one row per PA, row whose events non-empty. Outcome mapping. Statcast events mapped eight outcomes: strikeout, strikeout_double_play become strikeout. walk, intent_walk hit_by_pitch become walk. Hit--pitch folded result batter (reach first base). single, double, triple, home_run map . -play outs, fielder's choices, reached--error sacrifices (field_out, force_out, grounded_into_double_play, double_play, triple_play, fielders_choice, fielders_choice_out, field_error, sac_fly, sac_bunt, sac_fly_double_play, sac_bunt_double_play) become groundout bb_type == "ground_ball" flyout otherwise (fly ball, line drive, popup). Excluded: catcher_interf, rows complete PA (truncated_pa, caught_stealing_*, pickoff_*, stolen_base_*, wild_pitch, passed_ball, other_out, other_advance, runner_double_play, game_advisory, ejection). Combining batter pitcher. player's outcome counts shrunk toward league rates adding prior_pa pseudo-PAs league rates: \(\tilde p(o) = (n_o + k\,p_{lg}(o)) / (n + k)\). two combined odds-ratio (generalized log5) rule \(p(o) \propto p_{bat}(o)\,p_{pit}(o) / p_{lg}(o)\), normalized sum 1. default league baseline approximate, constant MLB average per PA: strikeout 0.23, walk 0.08, single 0.15, double 0.05, triple 0.005, home run 0.03, flyout 0.20, groundout 0.24, normalized total 0.985 1. season-specific. Supply league_rates use . Pitch type location. simulated PA pitch type sampled pitcher's mix PA-ending pitches, location 2D kernel density estimate (MASS::kde2d(), 50 x 50 grid, uniform jitter within grid cell) pitcher's PA-ending pitches type. Pitch types fewer 30 PA-ending pitches use KDE pitcher's PA-ending pitches. batter's hit rate (hits per PA) computed 0.5 ft bins plate_x (-2 2) plate_z (0 5) pitch type, shrunk toward batter's rate pitch type, shrunk toward overall rate (location_prior_pa). four hit outcomes multiplied bin rate / overall rate, clipped multiplier_range, probabilities renormalized. batter PAs bin, bin rate equals pitch-type rate; batter never ended PA pitch type, location falls outside bins, multiplier 1. missing bin never produces strikeout. Pitch types must match exactly (example, SI FF different pitches). Main simplification. simulated PA decided one sampled decisive pitch. count pitch sequencing modeled, park, handedness platoon adjustments beyond already player's data. location adjustment relative batter's average, pitcher's location tendencies partly reflected pitcher's outcome rates multiplier. Reproducibility. Simulations run fixed chunks 1000 PAs, chunk gets L'Ecuyer-CMRG random-number stream derived seed (parallel::nextRNGStream()). streams belong chunks rather workers, seed gives identical results num_cores. global random-number state restored function returns. warning issued either player fewer 50 PAs window.

title: Generate Hitter Performance Report — generate_hitter
text: function performs following hitter separately: Fetches player names using MLB Stats API. Fetches Statcast data Baseball Savant hitter date range. start_date end_date restrict dates; season filter. Identifies batted balls: plate appearances ending hit, -play , fielder's choice, error sacrifice. Calculates key metrics average exit velocity, launch angle, hard-hit rate, strikeout rate walk rate. Creates strike zone heatmap focusing central strike zone. Definitions: Plate appearances rows non-empty events value, excluding baserunning events truncated_pa. Hard-hit rate = batted balls exit velocity 95 mph / batted balls recorded exit velocity. Strikeout rate = (strikeout + strikeout_double_play) / PA. Walk rate = (walk + intent_walk) / PA. heatmap covers plate_x -1 1 ft plate_z 1 3.5 ft 0.5 ft cells, drawn catcher's view (negative plate_x third-base side).

title: Generate Pitcher Performance Report — generate_pitcher
text: function performs following steps pitcher separately: Fetches player names using MLB Stats API. Fetches Statcast data Baseball Savant pitcher date range. start_date end_date restrict dates; season filter. Calculates general statistics: batters faced, walk rate, strikeout rate whiff rate. Generates pitch-specific statistics: pitch count, usage, average velocity whiff rate. Creates strike zone heatmap frequently used pitch type whiff rate nine Statcast strike zones. Definitions: Plate appearances (batters faced) rows non-empty events value, excluding baserunning events caught_stealing_* pickoff_* truncated_pa. Strikeout rate = (strikeout + strikeout_double_play) / PA. Walk rate = (walk + intent_walk) / PA. Hit--pitch counted walk. Whiff rate = whiffs / swings. Whiffs swinging_strike, swinging_strike_blocked, foul_tip missed_bunt; swings whiffs plus foul, foul_bunt hit_into_play. Counting foul tips whiffs matches Baseball Savant's Whiff%. heatmap drawn catcher's view: zone 1 top-left (third-base side, high) zone 9 bottom-right (first-base side, low).

title: baseballscouting 0.1.0
text: Outcome probabilities now depend batter, pitcher, sampled pitch type location. Previously every matchup drew fixed league distribution, batter data sampled location bin always struck . Batter pitcher per-PA outcome rates shrunk toward league rates combined odds-ratio (generalized log5) method. Hit outcomes scaled batter’s smoothed hit rate sampled pitch type location. Rates per plate appearance (old code divided pitches). default league baseline normalized sum 1 (summed 0.985). Results longer fixed hard-coded set.seed(42). seed, results reproducible identical num_cores. function returns data frame instead printing . returned data frame lists eight outcomes fixed order carries "matchup" attribute inputs. New optional arguments: seed, league_rates, prior_pa, location_prior_pa, multiplier_range, game_types, verbose. Data now comes Baseball Savant request report functions. baseballr::statcast_search_*() (baseballr 1.6.0) fails current Savant CSV, baseballr longer dependency. Warns either player fewer 50 PAs window.

title: baseballscouting 0.1.0
text: Dates control data range. hard-coded 2024 season filter removed. Spring training excluded default. New optional game_types argument. pitcher strike-zone heat map orientation fixed: zone 1 top-left, catcher’s view. Whiff rate whiffs per swing, matching Baseball Savant’s Whiff%. color scale longer clips 0.2. K% BB% use every completed plate appearance denominator. Intentional walks count walks. Several player IDs now return named list per-player plots. Previously data blended first player’s name. Hard-hit rate excludes batted balls recorded exit velocity. hitter central-zone heat map now covers -1 1 ft horizontally. (0.5, 1] column previously dropped. general-stats tables add batters faced plate appearances, pitcher whiff rate, pitch usage hitter walk rate.
